messages:
maria: Auditor Sam requested a crosswalk for the RBAC consolidation (svc-ml/* and svc-infer/* -> role/platform-service) plus a signed evidence bundle by EOD.

ajay: Confirming the change. PR infra/iam#4123 merged 2026-02-10. Approver: @ajay. Security reviewer: @maria.

lee: I'll pull CloudTrail + KMS audit events (Encrypt, Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, Sign) and IAM events (AttachRolePolicy, PutRolePolicy, AssumeRole). Planning an S3 export slice.

nina: I can attach the PR diff and SEC-982 JIRA approval. I'll redact internal hostnames only per auditor guidance.

auditor-sam: Please include timestamps in UTC, a readable mapping: policy-diff -> affected key ARNs -> principals added/removed, and signed manifest (SHA256 + KMS sig). Hostnames may be redacted but keep full ARNs/principals UUIDs.

ajay: Proposed signing workflow:

# make manifest
jq -n '{files:["ct-slice-20260210.json","pr-4123-diff.txt","policy-eval.txt","coc.csv"],generated_at:"2026-02-10T18:00:00Z"}' > manifest.json
sha256sum ct-slice-20260210.json pr-4123-diff.txt policy-eval.txt coc.csv > manifest.sha256
cat manifest.json manifest.sha256 > bundle/manifest+digests.txt
aws kms sign --key-id alias/audit-signing-key --message fileb://bundle/manifest+digests.txt --message-type RAW --signing-algorithm RSASSA_PKCS1_V1_5_SHA256 --query Signature --output text | base64 --decode > bundle/manifest.sig

lee: ES query I'm running to extract GenerateDataKey events for 2026-02-09..2026-02-11:
GET /logs/_search
{ "query": { "bool": { "must": [ {"term": {"eventName": "GenerateDataKey"}}, {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "2026-02-09T00:00:00Z","lte": "2026-02-11T23:59:59Z"}}} ] } } }

lee: Export job export-20260210-ct-89 started at 2026-02-10T19:04:12Z (deploy-bot). Uploaded to s3://redwood-auditor-exports/2026-02-10/ct-infer-kms-slice.json (size 12.4MB). Run IDs: run-8812, run-8813.

maria: Auditor also asked whether any KMS keys were implicated in INF-721 / CVE-2026-0123 exploit chain (window 2026-02-09 to 2026-02-11). Needed: 2-line correlation statement.

lee: Quick triage: no anomalous GenerateDataKey calls from runtime containers. Noted a scheduled spike 2026-02-10T03:12Z from svc-infer-batch (run-8812) matched job history; attached container IDs. No ERROR-level KMS responses.

nina: Preparing PR diff (pr-4123-diff.txt) showing removal of explicit svc-infer-* allow statements and addition of arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/platform-service. Will attach SEC-982 approval thread and the PR approval snapshot.

auditor-sam: Please also include a one-line chain-of-custody CSV (timestamp, filename, action, actor) and a 2-3 sentence explanation of the policy-eval method (what command you ran and why it proves no external principals).

ajay: Policy-eval note: we diffed key policy JSON before/after, then ran our iam-policy-sim tool to enumerate allowed principals for each key ARN. Example command and sample output added to policy-eval.txt.

maria: I'll assemble evidence-bundle-20260210.tar.gz containing ct slice, pr diff, policy-eval.txt, coc.csv, README (pointer to INF-721) and upload to auditor bucket with presigned 7d link.

security-bot: export job export-20260210-ct-89 completed by lee.

ajay: Manifest created and signed; manifest.sig uploaded. Verification for auditors:
aws kms verify --key-id alias/audit-signing-key --message fileb://bundle/manifest+digests.txt --signature fileb://bundle/manifest.sig --signing-algorithm RSASSA_PKCS1_V1_5_SHA256

lee: Attached job and container IDs in the CT slice. No correlation to exploit beyond scheduled batch job activity.

maria: Evidence bundle uploaded. Presigned link (7d TTL): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-auditor-exports/evidence-bundle-20260210.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=604800

auditor-sam: Signature verified. One final ask: paste exact policy-diff snippet showing the platform-service allow statements so our control mapping team can match controls. Then we'll close. :white_check_mark: Appreciated for the fast turnaround.

maria: PR diff included with explicit allow for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/platform-service and removal of svc-infer-* entries. Closing the follow-up.
